meta.protocol: common trajectory: exact RTRL trains; all estimators are passive trackers fed the same (A_t, imm_t, delta_t) and the same lane resets; no tracker updates any parameter
meta.tbptt: not applicable -- TBPTT is not an online per-step estimator (one windowed autograd gradient at window end), so no per-step ghat_t exists on a common trajectory; see D4 for its task metric

skrtrl-r4.cert_overflow_note: n_rel_inf / n_bound_inf / n_tight_inf count steps whose certificate e_t had already overflowed float32 (rho_bar > 1 with no spectral clip); never counted as certifiable or tight
skrtrl-r4.counted_steps: labelled steps with step >= cert_warmup and age >= cert_min_age, stride cert_every
